name: mirage
text: You're right that the price is mine to set. What limits the count is how sure the fair value is, not the bid price. The top blocker is the rule you set on 10-31 that a bid needs one well-known book behind the fair (223 of the lines it rejects). I'm switching that rule off for bids now. The 3-books-agree rule and the sharp-book veto stay, so every bid is still +EV on its own fair. I'll tell you the bid count once it's running.
